logic.note: Open/closed contact between the two sides, legs on each side always tied.

timing.note: Switches instantly; real contacts bounce for 1–10 ms, which firmware must debounce.

analog.note: Closed contact is 0.01 Ω, open contact is a perfect open circuit.

power.note: Contact rating (50 mA, 12 V) is documented but not enforced.
